pages.text: Tonight was the full moon. Mom baked honey bread for moon-watching and packed it in a basket.
"I want to see the moon floating in the stream!" Mumu said. In still water, the moon comes down to float.
Dodo led with the basket. "I know the prime moon-watching spot! On the bridge! Closest to the moon!"
They climbed onto the bridge. But a big tree hid the moon.
Dodo tilted her head this way and that. Pieces of moon showed between branches.
"The moon is playing hide-and-seek behind the leaves!" Dodo stood on tiptoe.
Below the bridge, water rippled along. The moon broke into sparkling dust that flowed away.
Mumu went to the waterwheel pool. Its water was still as a mirror.
A full moon floated in the middle! One in the sky, one in the water.
They sat by the pool and ate honey bread. Dodo stood proud. "Of course! This is the prime spot I was saving!" The moon in the water rippled as if laughing.
